title: Voice-Memo Capture Habit
dataSources: Photos (`photo:capture`), places visited (`location:visit`), voice memos (`voicememo:note`), logged moments (`lifelog:moment`), timeline events (`timeline:event`).
app: Life-logging and memory telemetry — photo libraries (Google Photos, Immich), location history, voice memos, and daily-moment journals — streamed to Splunk HEC via APIs and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=voicememo:note
| bin _time span=1w
| stats count as memos, sum(duration_s) as seconds by _time
| eval minutes=round(seconds/60,1)
| sort - _time
description: Tracks how often you capture thoughts as voice memos and how much you record each week.
value: Voice capture is a low-friction way to hold onto ideas; tracking it reinforces a useful habit.
implementation: Ingest voice-memo metadata into `index=personal`; count and total duration per week.
visualization: Column chart of voice memos captured per week.
grandmaExplanation: It tracks how often you record quick voice notes, encouraging a simple way to hold onto ideas.
